title: Towards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.33511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. translated_title: 迈向面向文本图问答的可学习检索器
translated_abstract: 文本图问答和基于图的检索增强生成作为将大语言模型（LLM）建立在结构化知识之上的一种方式，正受到越来越多的关注。尽管已有大量研究，现有方法仍存在两个关键差距。第一个是架构差距：现有方法通常只微调基于LLM的生成器，却没有把检索器本身也做成一个可学习的LLM，用于在单一的端到端“先检索后生成”流水线中进行图证据选择。第二个是检索监督差距：现有检索器很少使用标准答案（gold answer）信号来监督证据选择。因此，它们可能无法召回推理所需的证据节点，导致对标准答案集合的覆盖不足；同时，提升召回率的朴素做法往往会引入过多无关信息，损害了紧凑性并使LLM不堪重负。为解决这些差距，我们提出……
tldr: 该论文提出将检索器本身构建为可学习的LLM，并在端到端的“先检索后生成”流水线中利用标准答案信号监督证据选择，从而提升对标准答案的覆盖同时避免引入过多无关信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes making the retriever itself a learnable LLM supervised by gold answer signals within an end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline, improving coverage of the gold answer set while avoiding excessive irrelevant information.
